title: QuantEval: unified metric layer and per-task validators for FP8/INT8 rollout gating
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Implement a canonical, extensible metric layer and task-specific validators used by the FP8/INT8 calibration pipeline. Goals: 1) provide reproducible, fast implementations of perplexity, MMLU-style accuracy, ROUGE/BLEU, QA F1/EM, and custom task scorers; 2) expose consistent confidence intervals and dataset-aware weighting for aggregated quality scores; 3) emit structured signals into Console for gating quant-profile rollouts; 4) plugin model-specific threshold configs to enable automated pass/fail decisions during calibration and canary rollouts.

Scope:
- Metric adapters for: perplexity (token-level and prefix-aware), multiple-choice accuracy (MMLU familes), QA F1/EM, ROUGE-1/2/L & ROUGE-Lsum, BLEU (sacreBLEU compatibility), chrF, and a generic reference-less similarity fallback.
- Per-task validator component: dataset split handling (dev/test), bootstrap CI, per-class breakdowns, and aggregated weighted-score output used by the calibration orchestrator.
- Integration points: eval harness (runner), quant-calibration workflow, scorer SDK (plugin interface), Console telemetry and alerting, and artifacts storage (S3) for golden references.
- Performance constraints: metric runs should be parallelizable across batches and support streaming evaluation for long-form outputs without full materialization.
- Acceptance criteria: documented scorers with reproducible outputs, unit and e2e tests, a sample run for Llama-variants and LlaMaQuant with both FP8 and INT8 profiles that produces gating decisions, dashboard tiles showing pass/fail and drift signals.

Trade-offs and decisions:
- Use sacreBLEU for canonical BLEU to avoid tokenization drift vs customer-specific tokenizers; provide hooks to swap tokenizer for customer datasets.
- Bootstrap-resampling for CI vs analytic approximations: bootstrap chosen for heterogeneous metrics and small dev sets.
- Reference-less fallback only for preliminary triage; gating requires reference-based metrics unless explicitly allowed by the customer.

Implementation plan (high level):
1) Spec metric adapters and canonical serialization format for predictions and references (JSONL schema). Link: https://confluence.internal.redwood/quant/metric-format
2) Implement core adapters in scorer-sdk (Python) with vectorized NumPy/JAX-friendly paths for large batch runs.
3) Add validator that computes weighted aggregates, bootstrap CIs, per-task thresholds loader (from runtime-1.21 release config).
4) Wire outputs into calibration orchestrator to produce pass/fail and detailed signal JSON sent to Console.
5) Dashboard tiles and alerts: work with PM/Console to add 2 tiles (quality-over-time, per-profile breakouts) and an alert rule for sudden drop (>5% absolute on weighted score) or CI overlap with fail threshold.
6) Run golden evaluations for FP8/INT8 on two internal testbeds and publish results.

Deliverables:
- scorer-sdk PR with adapters and tests: github: https://github.com/redwood-inference/scorer-sdk/pull/462
- calibration-run artifacts stored: s3://redwood-eval/quant/ENG-99001/
- Confluence design doc: https://confluence.internal.redwood/quant/quant-eval-metric-layer
- Console dashboard PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/1987
